scientific_integrity: Analytical strict-modulus proof for every harmonic. Finite numerical diagnostics corroborate formulas but are not infinite proof. No authorship, empirical prediction, or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for an uncalibrated one-store linear oxygen proxy with two positive fixed mixing rates, one harmonic prescribed demand, and a constant oxygen-saturation level. Spatial stratification, concentration-dependent metabolism, field observations, and actual hypoxia durations are not inferred. Historical novelty is provisional despite inspected literature; an older potentially relevant article was accessible only in abstract.
title: Every-harmonic phase sensitivity under two-level periodic lake reoxygenation
